title: Conversation lessons
summary: Study, listening and writing lessons: an exchange with an AI that ends in a verdict.
description: For what cannot be drilled: a grammar point, a song understood by ear, getting something across in writing. A conversation lesson coming back on its schedule is a check-in.

stories.as: a learner studying a grammar point
stories.want: to be questioned on it and told what to review
stories.soThat: I know whether I understood it

stories.as: a learner who needs to write Polish in real situations
stories.want: to play a situation out with a partner who only understands Polish
stories.soThat: I find out whether I can get my point across

requirements.text: A study lesson has a text and objectives; the examiner asks one question at a time and gives a line of feedback after each answer.
The examiner asks more questions the more complex the lesson: 2 to 3 for low, 4 to 6 for medium, 7 to 10 for high.
A conversation ends with a verdict of pass, partial or fail, with what to review.
A listening lesson plays a song with the lyrics hidden unless asked for, then the examiner asks about what was heard; the song can be replayed during the conversation.
A song the tutor makes gets a listening lesson unless the tutor opts out, and any song's page can start one.
A writing lesson is a situation with goals; the partner writes only Polish and answers anything it does not understand by saying so in Polish.
A writing conversation ends as soon as every goal has been got across, or when the learner ends it.
The writing partner has its own model setting and uses the tutor's model when none is chosen.
A writing lesson gives less help after each pass and more after a fail; a partial leaves the help as it is.
A writing lesson is mastered only once it has been passed without help.
A lesson built on Wikipedia keeps the examiner's questions to what the lesson and its sources say.
A check-in pays 30, 80 or 160 XP for low, medium or high complexity, plus 10 for each goal a writing lesson has; a partial pays half of that and a fail nothing.
